definitions.gloss: bar hopping; pub crawl; going from bar to bar
definitions.explanation: The practice of visiting multiple bars or drinking establishments in a single night, moving from one to the next like climbing rungs of a ladder.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}は{梯子酒|はしござけ}をしてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up bar hopping last night.

examples.japanese: {新橋|しんばし}で{梯子酒|はしござけ}をするのが{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to bar hopping in Shinbashi.

examples.japanese: {梯子酒|はしござけ}をして{三軒|さんげん}{回|まわ}ったら、{終電|しゅうでん}を{逃|のが}してしまった。
examples.english: After bar hopping through three places, I missed the last train.

notes:
USAGE:
{梯子酒|はしござけ} literally means "ladder drinking" — the image is of climbing from one bar to the next like rungs on a ladder. Also commonly written as はしご{酒|ざけ}. The verb form is {梯子酒|はしござけ}をする.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {梯子酒|はしござけ}をする (to go bar hopping)
- {梯子酒|はしござけ}で{三軒|さんげん}{回|まわ}る (to hit three bars while bar hopping)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- はしごする: casual shortened form (to hop from place to place — also used for non-drinking contexts like restaurant hopping)
- {二次会|にじかい}: second party/venue (after the main gathering)
- {飲|の}み{歩|ある}く: to drink and walk around
